seo.title: Career resources — CV, interview and offer guides
seo.description: What our recruiters wish every candidate knew — from the CV that gets read to the first 90 seconds of the interview. Includes an interactive CV checklist.

hero.title: Walk in prepared.
hero.lead: What our recruiters wish every candidate knew — from the CV that gets read to the first 90 seconds of the interview.

featured.title: The first 90 seconds of your interview
featured.text: A third of hiring managers say they know within 90 seconds whether they'll hire someone. Here's how to make that window count — arrival, greeting, posture and your opening answer.

guidesHeading.title: The essentials,
guidesHeading.lead: Quick, practical advice for every stage of a job move.

guides.title: CV checklist
guides.text: Recruiters skim before they read. Make the first scan easy.
points: Keep it to one or two pages

guides.title: Interview prep
guides.text: Preparation shows in the first minute — and the last question you ask.
points: Research the company, product and panel
Prepare 3–4 stories using situation, action, result

guides.title: Salary negotiation
guides.text: Negotiate on evidence, not nerves — and let your recruiter do the heavy lifting.
points: Know your current CTC breakdown precisely
Give a researched range, not a single number
Weigh the whole offer: role, growth, benefits

guides.title: Notice-period etiquette
guides.text: How you leave is remembered as long as how you joined.
points: Resign in person, then confirm in writing
Be upfront about your notice period from day one
Hand over cleanly and document your work

guides.title: Using LinkedIn
guides.text: Most recruiters will look you up. Make sure what they find helps you.
points: Match your headline and dates to your CV
Turn on "Open to work" for recruiters only

checklist.title: Is your CV
checklist.lead: Tick off each item as you go. Eight checks, about ten minutes — and your CV survives the 7-second scan.
items: Phone, city and LinkedIn URL up to date at the top
A 2–3 line summary tailored to the role you want
Achievements quantified with numbers, not just duties
Keywords and tools from the job description included
Consistent dates, with any gaps briefly explained
One or two pages, clean layout, saved as PDF
Proofread — no spelling or grammar slips
